{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Guess you never heard of the Smuggler's Click, huh? Sure did sound like I was trying to fire an empty blaster, didn't it?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Cronal|Kar Vastor]]|<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
The '''Smuggler's Click''' was a tactic in which one lightly pressed a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster's]] trigger to elicit a click sound, but never let it go past the break to fire the weapon. This led others into thinking that the blaster had run out of charges.<ref name="Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor" />
